build_conv_stack: build a stack of 1D convolutional layers with specified filters, kernel sizes, and strides
build_dense_stack: build a stack of dense layers with optional dropout regularization
create_encoding_layer: create an encoding layer that applies convolutional and fully-connected layers to encode sequence data
get_mask_for_discrete_domain: get a binary mask indicating valid token indices for a discrete domain
create_masking_layer: create a keras masking layer that maps invalid positions to a specified mask value
